# Planner — Progress Memory

> **This file is the agent's persistent memory.** The `Planner` agent
> (`.github/agents/planner.agent.md`) MUST read this at session start and update it at session
> end. Keep it accurate and current. Commit it together with the work it describes.

## Mission

Turn each changelog feature (from the Changelog Researcher's backlog) into a concrete,
step-by-step implementation plan for the `llm` VS Code extension. The planner does NOT write
code — only the Coder writes code.

## Active plan — 1.101-3 · MCP support for resources (VS Code 1.101)

- **Status:** Planned — 2026-10-24
- **Changelog:** VS Code 1.101 — MCP **resources** (including resource templates) are available: resources returned from tool calls can be saved in chat or dragged to Explorer; resources can be attached as context via Add Context; `MCP: Browse Resources` command. Relevance: keep (capability/context) — MCP capability.
- **Approach:** Extend the existing MCP client (1.99-2, 1.101-2) with the `resources/list`, `resources/templates/list`, and `resources/read` JSON-RPC methods. `resources/list` + `resources/templates/list` are best-effort discovery issued AFTER the tools/list handshake with their own short timeout (exact same pattern as `prompts/list` — the smoke test's fake MCP server only answers `initialize`/`tools/list`, so neither may join the handshake `Promise.all`). `McpManager` exposes `getServerResources` / `getServerResourceTemplates` (empty when not running, mirroring `getServerPrompts`) and a never-throwing `readResource(server, uri) → { content: string }`. Context attachment: a new `#mcp:<server>/<uri>` pill ref (kind `mcp`) — parsed by `parsePillRefs`, rendered in the pill strip, and resolved at send time in `handleSend` by reading the resource and folding its text into `ctxInput.taggedFiles` (synthetic path `mcp:<server>/<uri>`). The `llm.addContext` grouped quick-pick gains an "MCP Resources" category (server → resource two-step) that injects the `#mcp:` ref via the existing `context_inject` message. New `llm.browseMcpResources` command ("MCP: Browse Resources"): two-step quick pick (server → resource) that reads the resource and opens its text in a read-only untitled text document. Templates are listed (shown in the browse command with a "(template)" marker) but NOT instantiated — template URI expansion is out of scope (documented limitation). No new deps, no request-shape change.
- **Files to touch:** `src/mcp.ts`, `src/mcpManager.ts`, `src/context.ts`, `src/chat/ChatViewProvider.ts`, `src/extension.ts`, `src/chat/webview.ts`, `package.json`, `scripts/smoke-test.js`.
- **Slices:**
  - **S-001** — `src/mcp.ts` (1 file, pure): `McpResource` interface (`uri: string`, `name: string`, `description?`, `mimeType?`); `McpResourceTemplate` interface (`uriTemplate: string`, `name: string`, `description?`, `mimeType?`); `McpResourceReadResult` (`contents?: { uri: string; mimeType?: string; text?: string; blob?: string }[]`, `description?`); `mcpResourceReadToText(result) → string` (join `text` parts of `contents` with `\n`, skip blob-only parts, empty string when none); `parseMcpResourceRef(text) → { server, uri }[]` (regex `#mcp:([^\s/]+)/(\S+)` — server = first path segment, uri = rest; unique in order of first appearance; pure, no `vscode` import).
  - **S-002** — `src/mcp.ts` (1 file): `McpClient` + `McpHttpClient` — `public resources: McpResource[] = []` + `public resourceTemplates: McpResourceTemplate[] = []`; in `start()` after `loadPrompts()`, best-effort `loadResources()` (try/catch → `[]` on failure, `withTimeout(..., 2000)` each, issued AFTER the handshake resolves — never inside the handshake `Promise.all`); `readResource(uri) → McpResourceReadResult` via `resources/read` request.
  - **S-003** — `src/mcpManager.ts` (1 file): `McpClientLike` += `resources: McpResource[]`, `resourceTemplates: McpResourceTemplate[]`, `readResource(uri)`; `getServerResources(name) → McpResource[]` + `getServerResourceTemplates(name) → McpResourceTemplate[]` (empty when not running, mirrors `getServerPrompts`); `readResource(server, uri) → { content: string }` (never throws; unknown server / start failure / JSON-RPC error / no text content → `Error: ...` message; maps result via `mcpResourceReadToText`).
  - **S-004** — `src/context.ts` (1 file): `ContextPill.kind` += `"mcp"`; `parsePillRefs` recognizes `#mcp:<server>/<uri>` refs (reuse `parseMcpResourceRef`-equivalent regex — import from `src/mcp.ts` or duplicate the pattern; prefer importing to keep one source of truth) and emits pills with `kind: "mcp"`, `path: "<server>/<uri>"`, `label: "<uri basename>"`.
  - **S-005** — `src/chat/ChatViewProvider.ts` (1 file): in `handleSend`, after the file-pill consumption block, consume `mcp`-kind pills: for each, `mcpManager.readResource(server, uri)`; success → push `{ path: "mcp:<server>/<uri>", content }` into `ctxInput.taggedFiles`; failure → `postMessage({ type: "error", ... })` and skip that pill (never abort the turn).
  - **S-006** — `src/extension.ts` + `package.json` (2 files): `llm.addContext` quick-pick gains an "MCP Resources" category (shown when any configured server is running; description = total resource count) → second quick pick lists `<server> · <resource name>` entries → injects `#mcp:<server>/<uri>` via the existing `context_inject` message. New `llm.browseMcpResources` command ("MCP: Browse Resources", `package.json` `contributes.commands`): two-step quick pick (server → resource, templates listed with a "(template)" marker and disabled for reading) → `mcpManager.readResource` → open text in a read-only untitled document (`vscode.workspace.openTextDocument` + `showTextDocument`, `viewColumn: One`); read failure → `showErrorMessage`.
  - **S-007** — `src/chat/webview.ts` (1 file): pill strip renders `kind === "mcp"` pills (label + `$(server-process)` icon or existing pill styling; removal reuses the existing `remove_pill` path — no new host message needed).
  - **S-008** — `scripts/smoke-test.js` (1 file): new assertions — `mcpResourceReadToText` (text parts joined, blob-only skipped, empty); `parseMcpResourceRef` (valid, multiple, no match, server/uri split); `parsePillRefs` emits `mcp` pill for `#mcp:server/uri`; `McpClient` handshake issues `resources/list` + `resources/templates/list` and tolerates their failure (PassThrough fake server that only answers `initialize`/`tools/list` — startup must still succeed with empty arrays); `McpManager.getServerResources`/`readResource` (unknown server error, not-running → empty, success path via stub client); static source checks: `ChatViewProvider` consumes `mcp`-kind pills via `readResource`; `extension.ts` registers `llm.browseMcpResources` + the "MCP Resources" addContext category; `webview.ts` renders `mcp` pills; `package.json` contributes the command. Gate **828 → 843** (+15).
- **Acceptance criteria (whole item):** compile passes; smoke 843/843; servers without resource support start fine with zero resources/templates (handshake never stalls); `#mcp:<server>/<uri>` in the chat input shows a removable pill and its content is folded into the request context at send time; read failure → error posted in the panel, turn continues without that resource; `llm.addContext` offers an "MCP Resources" category that injects the `#mcp:` ref; `MCP: Browse Resources` opens a resource's text read-only; no new deps.
- **Risks:** `resources/list` / `resources/templates/list` unsupported by some servers → must be best-effort (never fail the handshake, same as `prompts/list`); resource URIs containing `#` or whitespace break the `#mcp:` pill grammar (documented limitation — such resources are still reachable via Browse Resources); templates are listed but not instantiated (URI template expansion deferred); binary resources (blob-only) have no text to inject — read yields empty content and the pill is skipped with an error note; `#mcp:` refs in the message text are resolved ONLY via the pill path (the `@`-tagged-file path is untouched).
- **Next item:** 1.101-4 · MCP support for sampling (Experimental).
